source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.locator: first displayed Open Problem 35 in Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)
source.target: determine explicit source-valid conditions on (P_n,Q_n) under which bounded low-degree advantage through D=(log n)^{1+Omega(1)} rigorously implies indistinguishability for a specified polynomial-degree class

methods.name: MAKE IT AN ALGORITHM
methods.result: Derived polynomial-description-size path constants from independent bounded null blocks and computed the needed intermediate-radius degree energy exactly by doubled bounded-treewidth junction-tree/tensor contraction.

methods.name: FIND THE EXTREMAL OBJECT
methods.result: Optimized the relaxed signed Metzler degree-path barrier: linear damping, finite downward bandwidth and a linear transition budget give R_t=[beta/kappa+(1-beta/kappa)e^{-w kappa t}]^(1/w) and a two-radius source-scale sufficient condition.

methods.name: READ THE FAILURES, NOT THE SUCCESSES
methods.result: Translated Mao exactly into a symmetrized binary-linear-code dual-orbit formula b_j=sum_O N_O^2/|O|. The obstruction is high-degree orbit-collision dual-weight-enumerator pressure surviving diagonal noise, not degree reassembly.

new_exact_results: Bandwidth/transition-budget signed path theorem with explicit pressure radius R_t
Two-radius energy-pressure corollary: log^+ F_{L-1}(v^2)=o(D) plus bounded LDA controls full noised chi-square
Independent bounded-block local-matrix certificate a_k>=kappa k, sum_{j!=k} c_jk<=2w beta0 k
Bounded-treewidth doubled-kernel identity computing 1+F_{L-1}(z) without Fourier enumeration
Symmetrized linear-code formula b_j=sum_{wt(O)=j}N_O^2/|O| and A_j^2/binom(|E|,j)<=b_j<=A_j
Mao obstruction identified as high-degree dual-code orbit-collision pressure with no generator reassembly
prior_art_cautions: MacWilliams identities and Delsarte dual-distance/orthogonal-array theory are classical
Reed–Muller weight enumerator/noisy-channel methods are classical
Junction-tree and bounded-treewidth tensor-network contraction are classical
Metzler comparison, characteristics, Dyson/Duhamel and semigroup path methods are classical
Negative search is not a novelty certificate
